subject: English
question_text: Change the narrative style of the following text.
stimulus: Rina said to Sima, "Why don't you get up early from sleep?" Sima said, "It is tough for me to leave bed early." "Alas! It is a bad habit," said Rima, "If you leave bed early, you can enjoy sound health. Follow my advice."
guide_solution: Changing the form of speech Rina asked Sima why she (S) didn't get up early from sleep. Sima replied that it was tough for her (S) to leave bed easly. Rina exclaimed with regret that it is a bad habit. She(R) added that she(S) could enjoy sound health if she(S) left bed early. Rina suggested to follow her(R) advice.
